name: MonarchAppearancePanel
title: AppearancePanel
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column of rows: MonarchThemeToggle, androidx.compose.material3.SingleChoiceSegmentedButtonRow for contrast, motion and density, MonarchSelect for the accent, separated by androidx.compose.material3.HorizontalDivider
summary: A settings panel for appearance with labelled, described rows for theme, contrast, accent, motion and density, bound to one MonarchAppearancePreferences value.
whenToUse: On an app's appearance or accessibility settings screen, to let people override the device's dark theme, contrast and motion settings and pick an accent.
whenNotToUse: For only the light, dark or system choice, use MonarchThemeToggle on its own.
api: @Composable fun MonarchAppearancePanel(preferences: MonarchAppearancePreferences, onPreferencesChange: (MonarchAppearancePreferences) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, title: String? = null, rows: List<MonarchAppearancePanelRow> = MonarchAppearancePanelRow.Standard, accents: List<MonarchAccent> = emptyList(), enabled: Boolean = true, labels: MonarchAppearancePanelLabels = MonarchAppearancePanelLabels())

data class MonarchAppearancePreferences(accent: MonarchAccent, scheme: MonarchScheme = MonarchScheme.System, contrast: MonarchContrast = MonarchContrast.System, motion: MonarchAppearanceMotion = MonarchAppearanceMotion.System, density: MonarchAppearanceDensity = MonarchAppearanceDensity.Comfortable) { fun reducesMotion(systemReducesMotion: Boolean): Boolean }
enum class MonarchAppearancePanelRow { Theme, Contrast, Accent, Motion, Density; companion object { val Standard: List<MonarchAppearancePanelRow> } }

class MonarchAppearancePanelLabels(theme: String? = null, themeDescription: String? = null, light: String? = null, dark: String? = null, system: String? = null, contrast: String? = null, contrastDescription: String? = null, contrastStandard: String? = null, contrastMore: String? = null, contrastSystem: String? = null, accent: String? = null, accentDescription: String? = null, motion: String? = null, motionDescription: String? = null, motionSystem: String? = null, motionReduce: String? = null, density: String? = null, densityDescription: String? = null, densityComfortable: String? = null, densityCompact: String? = null)

options.name: preferences
options.description: All choices, built with the starting accent, for example MonarchAppearancePreferences(accent = MonarchTokens.Accents.rook). Pass scheme, contrast and accent to MonarchTheme; apply motion and density in the app.

options.name: onPreferencesChange
options.description: Called with all the choices after any one changes. Store them here, for example in DataStore.

options.name: rows
options.description: The rows to show, in order, each once. The standard rows are theme, contrast, motion and density, as on the web; add Accent for the accent menu.

options.name: accents
options.description: The accents the accent row offers, usually MonarchTokens.Accents.all. The current accent is always offered, even when it is not in the list.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the choices can be changed.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for every built-in row label, description and choice name. Unset theme names keep MonarchThemeToggle's.

states.name: device settings
states.description: The default: System scheme, System contrast and System motion are selected, so the app follows the device's dark theme, contrast and animation settings.

states.name: overridden
states.description: Any row set to a fixed choice; its segment is selected with Material's check mark, or the accent field shows the chosen accent's name.

states.name: disabled
states.description: enabled false: every segment, the theme toggle and the accent field are disabled.

appearance: Rows separated by subtle dividers; each row's label in the label style and its description in the caption style in the muted color, then Material 3 segmented buttons or the outlined MonarchSelect field in the Monarch colors. All are theme roles, so light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow.
platformNotes: Same rows and names as iOS. The web panel writes the rook_theme and mn_contrast cookies and applies its choices to the html element; on Android the panel only reports the new value: the app passes scheme, contrast and accent to MonarchTheme and stores the choices. MonarchTheme reads the device's animation setting and has no motion input, so the motion choice is applied by the app's own animations through reducesMotion(systemReducesMotion); Monarch components keep following the device setting (a motion input on MonarchTheme is requested at merge). Density has no Monarch-wide meaning on Android yet; the app reads preferences.density. The accent row is native-only, because the plan asks for the accent as a theme input; the web panel has no accent row. The default theme is System, where the web default is Light, because Android apps follow the device. The parity map lists switch among the dependencies; the motion row is segmented System or Reduce, as on the web and iOS, instead of a switch. Unlike iOS, the accent has no default in MonarchAppearancePreferences and accents defaults to an empty list: Monarch components may not read MonarchTokens.Accents (a source rule keeps token primitives out of components), so the app passes the starting accent and the list.
accessibility: Each row's label and description are merged into one element, read before the row's control.
Contrast, motion and density are Material 3 single-choice segmented buttons named by the row label; TalkBack reads each choice with its selected state, and the chosen one also shows a check mark.
The theme row is MonarchThemeToggle, named by the row label.
The accent row is a MonarchSelect labelled by the row label; accents are chosen by name, not by color.
The title has the heading semantics.
Every segment and the accent field have a touch target of at least 48dp; descriptions wrap at the largest font size.
edgeCases: Long translated choice names wrap inside the segments; keep them short.
An accent that is not in accents is added to the end of the menu, so the current choice is always visible; with the default empty accents the menu offers only the current accent.
A row listed twice is shown once; an empty rows list shows only the title.
Accent names come from the tokens' MonarchAccent.label (English); an app that translates them passes its own MonarchAccent values or leaves the accent row out.

examples.template:
MonarchAppearancePanel(
    preferences = preferences,
    onPreferencesChange = { preferences = it },
    title = {{heading}},
    rows = listOf(
        MonarchAppearancePanelRow.{{rows.0|pascal}},
        MonarchAppearancePanelRow.{{rows.1|pascal}},
        MonarchAppearancePanelRow.{{rows.2|pascal}},
        MonarchAppearancePanelRow.{{rows.3|pascal}},
    ),
)
examples.code:
MonarchAppearancePanel(
    preferences = preferences,
    onPreferencesChange = { preferences = it },
    title = "Appearance",
    rows = listOf(
        MonarchAppearancePanelRow.Theme,
        MonarchAppearancePanelRow.Contrast,
        MonarchAppearancePanelRow.Motion,
        MonarchAppearancePanelRow.Density,
    ),
)
